description: Scan a code snippet for the vulnerability classes that show up most in generated code: injection, SSRF, hardcoded secrets, weak crypto, unsafe deserialization, disabled TLS, XSS. Regex rules matched line by line — no parser, no data flow, no taint tracking. JS/TS and Python only. Fully local. Runs fully locally: the input never leaves this machine.

language.description: python, javascript, typescript. Auto-detected if omitted.

name: scan_code
